Messages.Author: Jeroen du Chatinier
Messages.Body:
Reading the latest card-text of Obedience has left me a little bit
confused. The older card text of Obedience states that combat does not
occur. The latest Obedience card text:

Obedience

Only usable when this reacting vampire is about to enter combat with
an acting younger vampire.
[dom] Untap the acting vampire, do not tap this reacting vampire, and
end the current action (and combat). The acting vampire cannot attempt
the same action this turn.
[DOM] As above, but do not untap the acting vampire.

Does this imply that the action _and_ the combat are ended and so the
acting minion could Psyche!? I'd say he/she/it could. If not, what is
the reasoning behind it?

I am sorry if this is glaringly obvious, but my search of the
newsgroup yielded no results.

Jeroen du Chatinier

Messages.Author: The Fanboy
Messages.Body:
> Does this imply that the action _and_ the combat are ended and so the
> acting minion could Psyche!? I'd say he/she/it could. If not, what is
> the reasoning behind it?

Combat cannot occur outside of an action. Therefore, when the action
officially ends (by playing Obedience), the window in which Psyche!
could be played is never even opened.

That's my take on it.

Fanboy
